column1: # Owner ranges for tools/coverage.py (RE side). Game code (it stays in the denominator) whose functions have no name
# and that no reach edge can attribute, owned by link order. Rule 3b of docs/COVERAGE.md: after names and vtables, a
# function still without an owner whose entry lies in [start, end) takes the range's owner; named functions inside
# keep their own owner. Every range needs its evidence. Columns:
#   range     [start, end) virtual addresses, hex start-end
#   owner     the owner the map (tools/coverage-map.tsv) matches, a class or namespace
#   evidence  why (vtables, tables, callers and Mac names seen; checked against ghidra/export/windows on 2026-10-16)
range
# The software span renderer of cGZDrawContextRenderToBuffer (2D drawing). cGZDrawContextRenderToBuffer::Init 00830710
# (vtable 00AC17D0 slot 3) creates one of five span renderer classes by buffer color type, vtables 00AC182C cSpanRender1555
# / 00AC1844 565 / 00AC185C 4444 / 00AC1874 8888 / 00AC188C 8 (re/symbols/gzdraw-softrender.tsv, Mac slot order). Each
# class's five vtable methods are its link-order anchor, so the range is split at them rather than one blob: 1555 at
# 008310B0, 565 at 0083DE50, 4444 at 00847CE0, 8888 at 00854E10, 8 at 0085E640. Each RenderBlt indexes a 14 x 12
# dispatch table of template blit and texel-conversion instantiations (tables 00AC18A4-00AC1B40, 00AC1B88-00AC1E24,
# 00AC1E60-00AC20FC, 00AC2138-00AC23D4, 00AC2410-00AC26AC; 840 slots); those instantiations and the helpers they call
# are the 793 unnamed functions here (768 take this rule, the 25 vtable methods already carry a name). No code outside
# the range calls into it. The Mac build has 937 such nGZDrawSoftRender:: template functions (converttexel<RGBFormat...>,
# 250 KB). The last range ends where the EA sound library starts (coverage-libs.tsv easnd 00864b60).
